title: human-synapse-bouton-lab: Formally Verified Human Synaptic Bouton Biophysics, Stochastic Nanocolumn Simulator, and 11-Discipline Open Hard Problems Framework
description: Full-stack, formally verified human synaptic bouton biophysical workbench (TypeScript, Rust, Python, Lean 4.35.0), pre-registered stochastic Monte Carlo nanocolumn simulator, and two AMS-LaTeX white papers covering nanoscale synaptic biophysics and an 11-discipline map of open hard problems toward consciousness.
notes: Dual-licensed: Apache-2.0 for source code; CC-BY-4.0 for manuscripts, documentation, datasets, figures, and videos. Preprint artifacts; not peer-reviewed. Software Heritage SWHID: swh:1:snp:1a278fff55465dbe8d0b870408b6468822eb3e8b.
